integrity: The theorem has a complete symbolic proof and a separately executable finite diagnostic; diagnostic tests do not certify the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to one-sided words marking exact integer powers, not all sparse automatic words; neither full factor complexity nor the number of partial conjugacy classes is determined. Bibliographic search cannot eliminate unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact Lie classes and logarithmic Abelian divergence in geometric-marker automatic words
